entries.prompt: Sukhoi Su-30SM two-seat fighter of the Russian Aerospace Forces, exact head-on front view (camera on the aircraft's centreline at cockpit height, straight at the nose), standing on its landing gear on a concrete apron in daylight, photographic reference. Long drooped radome nose with the IRST ball ahead of the canopy, a long two-seat tandem bubble canopy, the canards on the leading-edge root extensions, the two widely spaced rectangular engine intakes under the wing roots, the two vertical fins standing upright over the engines, wingtip launch rails, the long single-wheel nose gear and the two main gear legs. Pale blue-grey two-tone camouflage with a white radome. Whole aircraft in frame and symmetric, no people, no text.

entries.prompt: Sukhoi Su-30SM two-seat fighter of the Russian Aerospace Forces, three-quarter rear view from the left and slightly above, standing on its landing gear on a concrete apron in daylight, photographic reference. Flanker airframe: the two widely spaced engine nacelles ending in round thrust-vectoring nozzles, the long central tail boom (stinger) between them, the two upright vertical fins over the engines, the all-moving tailplanes, the big swept wing with wingtip launch rails, the long two-seat tandem canopy and the canards on the leading-edge root extensions ahead of the wing. Pale blue-grey two-tone camouflage, red star on the fins. Whole aircraft in frame, no people, no text.
